text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon puts on an impressive 
performance at the Hanshin JF. The crowd's 
attention surges, and her juniors 
celebrate. Hishi Amazon feels her 
motivation burn even hotter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the Trainer was agonizing over 
which path to pursue going forward: the 
Triple Tiara or the Classic Triple 
Crown...
